===== PROBE =====
name: gpu.topo_matrix
started_utc: 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z
root_mode: none
run_as: root
requires: nvidia-smi
timeout_s: 120
runner: timeout -k 5 120 bash -o pipefail -c <command>
===== COMMAND =====
nvidia-smi topo -m
===== STDOUT =====
	GPU0	GPU1	GPU2	GPU3	CPU Affinity	NUMA Affinity	GPU NUMA ID
GPU0	 X 	SYS	SYS	SYS	0-95	0		N/A
GPU1	SYS	 X 	SYS	SYS	0-95	0		N/A
GPU2	SYS	SYS	 X 	PXB	0-95	0		N/A
GPU3	SYS	SYS	PXB	 X 	0-95	0		N/A

Legend:

  X    = Self
  SYS  = Connection traversing PCIe as well as the SMP interconnect between NUMA nodes
  PXB  = Connection traversing multiple PCIe bridges (without traversing the PCIe Host Bridge)
===== STDERR =====
===== RESULT =====
exit_code: 0
duration_s: 0.010
status: ok
note:
